title: Decca arrangements by Peter van Steeden and early difficulties recording
summary: During that time it was difficult to make records; Decca arrangements were by Peter van Steeden.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Making records: studios, takes and the technology

blocks.x: June. You went in for the whole season.
So when I came off the road, I decided I was going to go some place and get a little stationary.
During that time, it was very difficult for me to find -- to make records. It was touch and go so far as the record scene was concerned.
I did a couple of things with --
Yeah, this is where you go over to Decca.
Yeah, that's right. Those arrangements were made by Peter van Steeden, who is the musical director for Decca.
